policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Catawba have scored twenty-two and conceded three, and no one player has more than Alex Payton's four of those goals.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Emory & Henry have two published results, both draws, and both against the conference's unbeaten sides.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Six matches whose dates have passed carry no result: Newberry's opener at Converse, and the rest of them Emory & Henry's, from late August to mid-September.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Lenoir-Rhyne are still without a win: three draws and four defeats, nine scored and seventeen conceded, the latest a draw at home to Wingate on Sunday.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Newberry have won their last two after five defeats, and have scored nine and conceded sixteen.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Lincoln Memorial have scored eleven and conceded seven in three wins, a draw and two defeats; the latest defeat came at Newberry on Saturday.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Wingate's Cole Freeman has made twenty-seven saves and conceded three goals.
